notablePrerequisites: Opponents control at least eight artifacts and/or enchantments.
description:
Cast Dockside Extortionist by paying {1}{R}.
When Dockside Extortionist enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating at least eight Treasure tokens.
Activate seven Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}{U}{U}{U}{R}.
Activate Memnarch's first ability by paying {1}{U}{U}, causing Dockside Extortionist to become an artifact.
Activate Drafna's first ability by paying {1}{U}, returning Dockside Extortionist from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
